name: Windows Registry Run Key Persistence Added
description: Detects addition of a new startup program under HKLM or HKCU CurrentVersion\Run registry keys.
explanation: Registry Run keys are the most prevalent persistence mechanism on Windows, automatically executing registered binaries on user login.
investigation_steps: Inspect the path and command stored in the new registry value.
Check the digital signature and SHA-256 hash of the target executable.
Identify the process that performed the registry write.
